body.name: Stabilizer-weighted observation-hypergraph kernel
body.construction: For response histogram \(\kappa\), assignment histogram \(n\), and compatible observation histogram \(\omega\), let \(F_{\kappa,q}(z)=\prod_t(\sum_{a,u,v}P_{t,a}(u,v)z_{a,u,v})^{\kappa_{q,t}}\) and \(H_{\kappa n\omega}=\prod_{q=3}^{b}[z^{\omega_q}]F_{\kappa,q}(z)/\binom{m_q}{(n_{q,a})_{a\in\mathcal A}}\); set the entry to zero when the label margins are incompatible.
